entries.ffdcef1036be6f64: In October 2023, the company formulated its medium- to long-term management plan "Honoo no Scrum," with the fiscal year ending March 2028 as its final year. Its vision is "Connecting cars and homes through manufacturing that contributes to the global environment," and it is advancing technology and product development toward a carbon-neutral society by leveraging the sales strengths it has across its three businesses. Its targets are to remain the global market leader in ignition coils in the Automotive Equipment Business, to maintain its leading domestic market share in residential storage battery systems in the Energy Solutions Business, and to become the leading market share holder in reactors for domestic inverter air conditioners in the Electronic Devices Business. In new businesses, it is working to establish ignition and combustion technologies for next-generation fuels such as ammonia combustion, thermoelectric generation systems, regional decarbonization and microgrids, and battery diagnostic technologies.
